item.title: Connacht farmers to join in on protest
item.description: HUNDREDS of farmers are expected to converge on Claremorris this evening [Thursday] for a public protest meeting over the refusal of Bord Bia Chair, Larry Murrin, to step down from his position in light of his Brazilian beef and poultry imports. item.title: VW group celebrates record sales figures for last year ahead of an exciting 2026
item.description: There is a great sense of achievement emanating from the Volkswagen Group headquarters in Ireland with their improved sales figures for 2025.
